claim_boundary: all historical dates have been visible to prior CZSC research and are not independent OOS
the 2024plus segment is opened only after the development gate but remains retrospective temporal validation
a pass creates a candidate for a separate self-financing implementation and forward test only
a failure closes this exact continuous reversal definition without lookback, neutralization, target-size, or holding-period rescue

mechanism.hypothesis: industry- and size-neutralized one-week losers mean-revert over the next week after realistic membership turnover costs
mechanism.distinct_from_failed_fsm_reversal: continuous cross-sectional oversold residual over the full eligible universe, not a sparse transition from FSM state 1 into states 2/3/4

signal.raw_return: decision close divided by the fifth prior observed stock close minus one
signal.winsorization: within decision date at 1st and 99th percentiles for raw return and log free-float market cap
signal.neutralization: weekly OLS raw_return ~ intercept + zscore(log_free_float_mcap) + SW2021_L1 industry dummies with deterministic sorted columns
signal.score: negative OLS residual so the most idiosyncratically oversold stock ranks first

portfolio.recursive_membership: retain previous names if current reversal rank<=75, then fill by reversal rank and symbol
portfolio.outcome: fifth common market-session open return from entry
portfolio.missing_or_untradable_selected_slot: zero return cash proxy and separately report completeness

benchmark.definition: same-week equal-weight mean fwd_5d_open_return of every finite entry-tradable eligible stock
benchmark.reason: a deliberately hard theoretical all-eligible benchmark removes broad market direction without granting a turnover advantage to the candidate

statistics.estimand: weekly candidate net return minus theoretical all-eligible gross benchmark return

decision_rules.development_pass: mean active net return>=0.25% weekly; one-sided HAC p<0.05; block-bootstrap q05>0; both development-half active means>0; candidate net mean>0; observable target slot rate>=98%; compounded candidate max drawdown<=35%
decision_rules.validation_opening: validation returns, statistics, and artifacts must not be computed or persisted unless every development gate passes
decision_rules.validation_pass: same fixed rules and both locked validation-half active means>0
decision_rules.cost_stress_pass: at 60bp roundtrip both development and validation active means and bootstrap q05 remain positive
decision_rules.candidate_status: RETROSPECTIVE_REVERSAL_CANDIDATE_DAILY_PATH_AND_FORWARD_TEST_REQUIRED only if development, validation, and 60bp stress all pass
decision_rules.failure_status: HYPOTHESIS_FALSIFIED_RETROSPECTIVE; no alternate lookbacks, neutralizers, target sizes, buffers, or holding horizons in this study
